title: FrogJump
description: This plugin allows players to perform powerful leaps using Lily Pads as a consumable item. It’s a simple, fun way to add unique movement mechanics and sound effects to your server.
body: ![nh](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/db96f08f492614553d97a120226851e3a63231e4.png)The FrogJump plugin enhances your Minecraft experience by introducing a fun and functional movement mechanic inspired by nature. Players can perform a powerful leap into the air simply by left-clicking while holding a Lily Pad in their main hand. This action boosts the character in the direction they are looking and triggers a satisfying slime jump sound effect. To keep the gameplay balanced, each jump consumes exactly one Lily Pad from the player's inventory. It is a lightweight and intuitive tool perfect for parkour maps or adding a unique touch to survival exploration.
